== Build notes (October 2026) ==

Deck size history: billbisco/swccg-gemp commit 53f5b8e3 (pull request 256, 5 October 2026) changed <code>cube</code>, both Watto's Cube formats and the four draft formats from 45 to 40 cards. PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public at commit 5e26dd19 still sets <code>cube</code> to 45. The 45-card statements from the Players Committee Cube page and the Alternate Format Tournament Guide stay as written, with the GEMP values added beside them. This also covers [[Premiere - Death Star II Draft]], [[Premiere - Virtual Set 13 Draft]], [[Premiere - Virtual Set 25 Draft]] and [[Cube v7 + Objectives Draft]].
